meta.description: F2L case library volume 4 - dense coverage for hard states targeting fallback elimination
notes: All setups assume white cross solved on bottom, FR is the target slot
Apply setup from solved state to reproduce the case
Algs solve the case from the reproduced state
Notation: R L U D F B and their primes and 2s only unless unavoidable
Cases are grouped by the structural state of the corner and edge pieces
corner_loc and edge_loc fields describe where pieces are before applying setup
orientation codes: U=white up, F=white facing front, R=white facing right, L=white facing left, B=white facing back
